summary: KHEOBA Ltd, a Singapore-domiciled computer programming services company, furnished a Form 6-K for the period ended April 30, 2026, comprising interim financial statements and XBRL exhibits for the six months then ended. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation appears; the filing is a routine semi-annual reporting update with revenue by segment, related-party balances, and customer-concentration disclosures. There is no special-situation catalyst, no deal terms, and no structural or regulatory clock to trade against.
